draft.unsupported-schema-description: This draft uses content schema version {{version}} ({{type}}), which is not supported by this version of the application. It can be viewed but not edited.

commands.publish-acknowledge-warnings: I have reviewed these warnings and want to publish anyway
commands.withdraw-description: Withdrawing stops this version from being used for anything new and blocks new work that depends on it. History, existing assets and live ads are not changed.
commands.withdraw-clears-current: This is the entry's effective version. After withdrawal the entry has no effective version until a new one is published.
commands.withdraw-no-dependents: No published version depends on this one.
commands.withdraw-dependents: Published versions that depend on this one: {{count}}. Newly blocked from new use: {{blocked}}.
commands.withdraw-dependent-blocks: {{type}} v{{no}}: will be blocked from new use
commands.archive-description: Archiving this entry prevents it from being used in new contexts.
commands.archive-not-deletion: Archiving blocks new use — it does not delete the entry or its history.
commands.archive-confirm-checkbox: I understand this blocks new use of this entry
commands.fork-description: Copy this version of {{name}} into a new entry's draft. The new entry evolves on its own.
commands.clone-description: Create a new product draft from {{name}}. The description, must-match requirements, dimensions and reference bindings are copied.
commands.clone-never-copied: Offers, prices, market mappings and landing pages are never copied. Create them for the new product separately.

reconciliation.lookup-in-progress: We're checking whether your last action was applied. Please wait.
reconciliation.unresolved-ambiguity: The outcome of an action submitted on {{date}} could not be determined. Check the entry's event log before retrying.
reconciliation.not-applied: The server confirmed this action was not applied. You can safely retry.

denied.owner_required: Only the Workspace Owner can do this
denied.entry_type_mismatch: Only Product entries can be cloned

commands.denied-default: This action isn't available right now

data-source.adapter-invalid: The saved source type is not one of the options. Choose a source type again.

data-source.execution-mode-mismatch: The saved execution mode does not match the source type. Choose the source type again.

references.drop-or-browse: Drag and drop a file, or click to browse
references.upload-complete: Upload complete — reference has been released.
references.upload-complete-bound: Upload complete — the reference was published and bound to this draft.
references.rights-confirm: I confirm this workspace holds the rights to use this image as a reference for the declared scope and period.
references.confirm-rights-first: Confirm the rights declaration to enable uploads
references.content-safety-unavailable-hint: The upload was kept in quarantine. Ask an operator to configure LIBRARY_CONTENT_SAFETY_MODE on the Worker, then upload again.
references.draft-bindings-empty: No references are bound in the draft yet. Upload one above or pick a published reference with Bind Reference.
references.draft-bindings-hint: Draft bindings take effect for generation once this entry is published.
references.file-too-large: Choose an image of {{mb}} MB or smaller.
references.file-type-not-supported: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

template-reapply.description: Compare the latest template version against the local dimension schema and merge changes.

data-source-ops.connection-description: Checks this data source's published version, whether a connector exists for it, and the state of its bound credential. MarketAI does not contact the provider.
data-source-ops.check-not-confirmed: We could not confirm that the check started. Check again.
data-source-ops.outcome-uncertain: The check outcome is uncertain. Check again later.

outcome.data_source_not_published: Publish this data source first, then check it.
outcome.data_source_config_invalid: The published version's configuration is not valid. Fix it and publish again.
outcome.adapter_not_enabled: There is no connector for this kind of data source yet.
outcome.credential_not_active: The bound credential version was rotated or revoked. Bind a valid credential.
outcome.manual_source_no_connection: Manual data sources need no connection: their facts come from imports.
outcome.controlled_mock_source: This is a Controlled Mock data source. It does not connect to a real provider.

data-source-ops.outcome-other: The check finished with a result this page cannot describe.
data-source-ops.import-description: Import facts from a CSV or JSON file. Each import creates a new fact set draft.
data-source-ops.default-offer-none: None: every row names its offer
data-source-ops.default-offer-help: Rows that name no offer (offer_entry_id) get this one. A row that names its own offer keeps it.
data-source-ops.default-offer-unavailable: Offers could not be loaded. Each row must name its offer.
data-source-ops.import-complete: Facts imported into a new fact set draft. Its Draft tab lists any rows to fix before publishing.
data-source-ops.import-uncertain: We could not confirm whether the import finished. Check the library for a new fact set draft before importing again.
data-source-ops.import-not-confirmed: We could not confirm that the import started. Check the library for a new fact set draft, then try again.
data-source-ops.upload-failed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
data-source-ops.upload-rejected: The file did not pass the upload checks. Use a CSV or JSON file of up to 10 MB.
data-source-ops.import-rejected: This file could not be imported: use a UTF-8 JSON file with a "facts" list, or a CSV file with a header row, holding 1 to 10,000 facts in no more than 10 MB.

fact-list.empty: This fact set has no facts yet.
fact-list.unreadable: These facts cannot be shown here.

problems.draft: This draft has problems that block publishing. The Draft tab lists each reason.

validation-findings.binding_duplicate: The same reference version is bound twice for the same purpose and viewpoint.
validation-findings.binding_priority: Priority must be a whole number of 0 or more.

validation-findings.binding_viewpoint: Each reference binding needs a viewpoint.

brand_policy.invalid_claim_switches: Claim switches must be an object.

validation-findings.circular_reference: This draft refers back to its own entry, directly or through its dependencies.
validation-findings.combination_limit_exceeded: These dimensions make more combinations than the limit allows. Remove values or add constraints.
validation-findings.constraint_cycle: The requires constraints form a loop.
validation-findings.content_shape: The draft content must be a JSON object.
validation-findings.dependency_archived: The referenced entry is archived and cannot be newly referenced.
validation-findings.dependency_blocked: The referenced version is blocked and cannot be used.
validation-findings.dependency_not_found: The referenced version does not exist or has not been published yet.
validation-findings.dependency_type_mismatch: The referenced version is not of the entry type this field expects.
validation-findings.dependency_warning: The referenced version can be used but has a warning. Review it before publishing.
validation-findings.dependency_withdrawn: The referenced version has been withdrawn.
validation-findings.ds_config_shape: The configuration must be an object.
validation-findings.ds_execution_mode: The execution mode is missing or is not real or mock.
validation-findings.ds_execution_mode_mismatch: The execution mode does not match the source type. Choose the source type again.
validation-findings.fact_amount_invalid: The amount must be a finite number.

validation-findings.fact_amount_parse: The amount is not a valid decimal number.
validation-findings.fact_bool_invalid: This value must be true or false.
validation-findings.fact_country_code: Use a two-letter upper-case ISO country code, such as US.
validation-findings.fact_currency: Use a three-letter upper-case ISO 4217 currency code, such as USD.
validation-findings.fact_date_format: Write the date in ISO form, such as 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T09:00:00Z.
validation-findings.fact_days_invalid: Days must be a whole number of 0 or more.
validation-findings.fact_days_range: The maximum delivery days cannot be less than the minimum.
validation-findings.fact_duplicate_id: Another fact already uses this fact ID.
validation-findings.fact_evidence_source_required: Say where this fact comes from (evidence_source), such as the price list or contract it was taken from.
validation-findings.fact_expired: This fact has already expired. Localization skips it and keeps using the other facts.
validation-findings.fact_id_required: Each fact needs a stable fact ID.
validation-findings.fact_offer_market_scope: This offer does not sell in this fact's market. Choose an offer for this market, or correct the market.
validation-findings.fact_offer_not_found: This is not an offer of this workspace. Use the ID of one of your offers.
validation-findings.fact_offer_required: Name the offer this fact belongs to (offer_entry_id), or choose a default offer when you import.
validation-findings.fact_offer_unpublished: This offer has no published version yet. Publish the offer first.
validation-findings.fact_set_ds_required: Choose the data source these facts come from.
validation-findings.fact_shape: Each fact must be an object.

validation-findings.fact_valid_from: Set the date this fact is valid from.
validation-findings.fact_valid_range: The fact must stop being valid later than it starts.
validation-findings.fact_valid_to: Set the date this fact is valid until.
validation-findings.forbidden_field: This field is not allowed here: it belongs to another entry type or to a credential.
validation-findings.group_member_duplicate: This reference version is already a member of the group.

validation-findings.group_member_shape: Each member must be an object.
validation-findings.group_member_target: Each member must name a reference version.
validation-findings.group_members: A reference group needs at least one member.
validation-findings.mapping_data_source: Choose the data source version; there is no default data source.
validation-findings.mapping_execution_mode_mismatch: The execution mode must match the referenced data source version. Mock and real cannot be mixed.

validation-findings.mapping_external_object: Name the external object this mapping points to.
validation-findings.mapping_market: The market must be a two-letter ISO country code, such as US.
validation-findings.mapping_offer: A market source mapping must refer to an offer version.
validation-findings.must_match_description: Each must-match requirement needs a description.
validation-findings.must_match_duplicate_id: Another must-match requirement already uses this ID.

validation-findings.must_match_id: Each must-match requirement needs a stable ID.

validation-findings.must_match_unconfirmed: Confirm this AI-proposed must-match requirement before publishing.
validation-findings.must_match_viewpoints: List the viewpoints this requirement applies to.

validation-findings.offer_claims: Claim constraints must be a list.
validation-findings.offer_item: An offer needs a structured item: SKU, variant, quantity and bundle.
validation-findings.offer_landing_page: An offer must set its landing page.

validation-findings.offer_market_scope: An offer must list the markets it applies to.
validation-findings.offer_product: An offer must refer to a product version.
validation-findings.offer_quantity: The quantity must be a whole number greater than 0.
validation-findings.offer_valid_from: Set the date this offer is valid from.

validation-findings.person_age_expression: A person needs an age expression.

validation-findings.person_rights_channels: List the channels the rights cover.
validation-findings.person_rights_evidence: Licensed talent needs evidence of the license.
validation-findings.person_rights_regions: List the regions the rights cover.

validation-findings.person_rights_valid_to: Licensed talent rights need an end date.
validation-findings.person_type: The person type must be fictional or licensed_talent.

validation-findings.product_spec_value: A spec value must be text and not too long.
validation-findings.product_specs_shape: Specs must be an object of name-value pairs.
validation-findings.product_specs_too_many: There are more specs than allowed.
validation-findings.product_variant_duplicate: Another model variant already has this label.

validation-findings.protected_phrase_restored: A protected phrase was removed and has been restored automatically. Review it before publishing.
